name: flow_coverage_row
description: The hub's coverage row lights the checks any party member's main is strong against (content.gd BUILDERS covers): alone as a Lamplighter Swarm and Swift; with a Lookout in the party all four; with two Lamplighters Armored and Winged stay dim, and hovering a dim one says nobody here is strong against it.

steps.msg: a Lamplighter alone covers Swarm and Swift
dim checks are dimmed, lit ones full

steps.assert: node('Check_winged').tooltip_text == 'Winged · Spindrift\nNobody here is strong against Winged'
steps.msg: a dim check says nobody here covers it
the Lookout lights Armored, and the tooltip names her
two Lamplighters leave Armored and Winged dim

steps.assert: node('Check_armored').tooltip_text == 'Armored · Ballast\nNobody here is strong against Armored' and node('Check_swift').tooltip_text == 'Swift · Runnel\nStrong: Lamplighter'
